description: A residential tower whose ground floor has been re-clad twice and whose upper floors have not been touched since before the Handoff, so the building changes texture at the third storey like a tidemark. Satellite dishes and washing lines share the balconies. The lobby door is glass, propped open with a fire extinguisher, and the intercom panel carries more tape than buttons. The lobby is west; Ironside Street runs east.
name: The Meridian - Lobby
